_note: Tier 2 batch w09, 20-24 November 2025. The 22 and 23 November streams cover the same glory-wave material twice; both tellings are extracted and assigned to the same claims.

mentions.claim_text: Pillars of particular people seen on every continent, including Africa and South America.
mentions.quote: there were pillars of certain people through every continent
mentions.falsify_match: Simultaneous revival movements on several continents.

mentions.claim_text: He hears the Ukrainian president saying Trump is turning his back on him, with Macron and others wanting war.
mentions.quote: Trump's turning his back on me
mentions.falsify_match: An open American break with Kyiv while Europe pushes on.

mentions.claim_text: A plan to take him out and install a proxy government under an elderly man, with an assassination he declines to attribute.
mentions.quote: I saw them assassinating him and I won't tell you who is
mentions.falsify_match: An assassination followed by a proxy government.

mentions.claim_text: He says a conspiracy will stop being so much a conspiracy, and denies that the answer is Israel.
mentions.quote: a conspiracy will not become a conspira so much a conspiracy
mentions.falsify_match: A widely dismissed theory confirmed publicly.

mentions.claim_text: They are lying to Trump because their agenda is their Mahdi, making financial agreements with a hidden meaning.
mentions.quote: what they want is their madi
mentions.falsify_match: An agreement shown to carry a religious objective concealed from Washington.

mentions.claim_text: Viewer questions read out about whether England went to war and about other topics.
mentions.quote: They're asking about England. Did they go to war?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: questions read from the chat.

mentions.claim_text: He is told to look up the 1930 chart of the Great Depression and shows it on screen.
mentions.quote: The Lord told me to look up 1930 chart
mentions.falsify_match: A market path matching the 1930 chart.

mentions.claim_text: Glory waves arriving with eyes, ears, hands, feet and body parts from the reserves, with creative miracles flowing in Africa.
mentions.quote: body parts from my reserves are coming UNTO THEE
mentions.falsify_match: Documented creative miracles at scale.

mentions.claim_text: Eyes of every colour, healings of hearts, livers and intestines, and brand new colons for those who have had them removed.
mentions.quote: I see brand new colons
mentions.falsify_match: Medically documented regeneration of removed organs.

mentions.claim_text: America told to get out of natural thinking, with it happening in Africa like ripe cherries falling off a tree.
mentions.quote: it's happening like ripe cherries off a
mentions.falsify_match: A reported wave of healings in Africa.

mentions.claim_text: Let the Holy Ghost flow through America as he does in Africa, without the traditions of men.
mentions.quote: LET HIM FLOW ON THROUGH th America
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an exhortation about worship style.

mentions.claim_text: Taiwan and the edge of China seen, with a glory wave over Africa and over Asia.
mentions.quote: I see a glory wave just like I'm talking about over Africa
mentions.falsify_match: Revival reported across Asia and Africa together.

mentions.claim_text: A wave of glory going into Japan, North Korea and Taiwan through prayer.
mentions.quote: it's going into North Korea, it's going into Taiwan
mentions.falsify_match: Reported religious movement in those countries.

mentions.claim_text: The wave reaching even into eastern Russia, with China and North Korea affected.
mentions.quote: even over into Russia
mentions.falsify_match: Religious movement reported across that region.

mentions.claim_text: Times ten: take what happened at Brownsville and magnify it by ten, beyond anything any of them have experienced.
mentions.quote: Take what happened at Brownsville and magnify it by 10
mentions.falsify_match: A revival recognised as larger than Brownsville.

mentions.claim_text: A girl who will bring heavenly worship like a fragrance, and he says he can see where she lives.
mentions.quote: she'll bring heavenly worship and it'll be a fragrance unto me
mentions.falsify_match: A previously unknown worship leader rising to prominence.

mentions.claim_text: Creative ideas coming to people in Canada where the finances are drying up, making it a distribution centre with a well of revival money.
mentions.quote: You will be a distribution center for creative ideas
mentions.falsify_match: An identifiable wave of Canadian innovation funding ministry.

mentions.claim_text: A great revival in Arizona among American Indians on tribal land, extending over Mexico and New Mexico.
mentions.quote: I see a great revival coming in Arizona
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival among Native American communities in the southwest.

mentions.claim_text: A pastor will show up in California and there will be a great red wave and a great move of his presence there.
mentions.quote: a great great move of my presence in California
mentions.falsify_match: A revival and a conservative swing in California together.

mentions.claim_text: The subject is the two-state solution and what happens to America if Jerusalem is split under the Saudi crown prince's plan.
mentions.quote: What will happen to America if we split Jerusalem?
mentions.falsify_match: A partition of Jerusalem agreed under that plan.

mentions.claim_text: A ten point zero earthquake setting off fault lines from Texarkana up through Tulsa, with six point zero further out.
mentions.quote: a massive earthquake but it set off fault lines in Tex Arcana
mentions.falsify_match: A great earthquake on that line.

mentions.claim_text: Chinook helicopters flying east toward the Mississippi because supplies could not be brought in by road.
mentions.quote: the sound of the Chinook helicopters coming in
mentions.falsify_match: An airlift response to a central US disaster.

mentions.claim_text: A lion he is told to pay attention to, on the New York Stock Exchange, with tumbleweeds rolling down the main street.
mentions.quote: But it was on the New York Stock Exchange
mentions.falsify_match: A collapse leaving the exchange deserted.

mentions.claim_text: America divided and the Mississippi River flowing a different way, which he calls catastrophic.
mentions.quote: the Mississippi River was flowing different
mentions.falsify_match: The Mississippi's course altered by an earthquake.

mentions.claim_text: Do not divide the land of Israel, because those who bless Israel are blessed and those who curse it are cursed.
mentions.quote: Do not divide the land of Israel
mentions.falsify_match: A partition followed by disaster in the country that signed it.
mentions.falsify_miss: A partition with no such consequence.

mentions.claim_text: It is catastrophic for America and will happen three days after any president signs such an agreement.
mentions.quote: it will happen 3 days after you do this
mentions.falsify_match: A catastrophe within three days of an American president signing a land-division agreement.
mentions.falsify_miss: Such an agreement signed with nothing following.

mentions.claim_text: Rebuilding a bridge and the infrastructure afterwards would be something of biblical proportions.
mentions.quote: it will be uh something of biblical proportions
mentions.falsify_match: Bridge and infrastructure loss on that scale.

mentions.claim_text: He is going to break that well open and a mighty rushing water will come up out of it, and it will come to pass at last.
mentions.quote: there's going to be come a mighty rushing water
mentions.falsify_match: A visible release of the thing he says has been held back.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: no threshold given.

mentions.claim_text: White t-shirts and children worshipping with a named worship leader, with a major move of God among the youth.
mentions.quote: I saw the white t-shirts and all the the kids worshiping
mentions.falsify_match: A youth revival at that scale.

mentions.claim_text: A great revival among the youth, with what is happening now offered as the first fruits of it.
mentions.quote: It's the first fruits of it
mentions.falsify_match: A youth movement developing from the current stirrings.

mentions.claim_text: A YouTuber whose channel is about exposing scammers who steal card details.
mentions.quote: he has a channel about tha
mentions.falsify_match: That figure becoming publicly Christian.

mentions.claim_text: He tells listeners to stop thinking small about whom God can use.
mentions.quote: Stop thinking so small
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: He says he never stands against Israel, citing the blessing and cursing.
mentions.quote: I NEVER STAND AGAINST ISRAEL
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a statement of his own position.

mentions.claim_text: Body parts arriving in the wave from the reserves, before the previous wave has even receded.
mentions.quote: BODY PARTS FROM M
mentions.falsify_match: Documented creative miracles at scale.

mentions.claim_text: Healings of intestines and new colons, with what the cankerworm ate restored.
mentions.quote: HE'S GOING TO RESTORE BACK WHAT THE CANKER WORM ATE
mentions.falsify_match: Medically documented restoration of removed organs.

mentions.claim_text: It is happening like ripe cherries off a tree, in Africa and in the middle, for those who will believe.
mentions.quote: It's happening so much in the Middle
mentions.falsify_match: A reported wave of healings.

mentions.claim_text: Let him flow through South America without the tradition of man, with the waves seen coming.
mentions.quote: LET HIM FLOW ON THROUGH South America
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival across South America.

mentions.claim_text: Taken from Africa to Asia, seeing South Korea, Taiwan and the edge of China.
mentions.quote: I'm seeing Asia. I'm over Asia
mentions.falsify_match: Revival reported across east Asia.

mentions.claim_text: South Korea will be a hub, with a major pillar of revival springing from it and spreading through China and Vietnam.
mentions.quote: A major PILLAR OF REVIVAL WILL WILL SPRING FORTH FROM SOUTH Korea
mentions.falsify_match: A revival originating in South Korea and spreading.

mentions.claim_text: Upon this rock I will build my church, said over South Korea.
mentions.quote: It's over South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: South Korea becoming the centre of a movement.

mentions.claim_text: As it happens in South Korea it affects Alaska and Hawaii, a tsunami wave of glory, which he calls a hot spot.
mentions.quote: It has an effect on Alaska
mentions.falsify_match: Movement reported in Alaska and Hawaii following one in South Korea.

mentions.claim_text: Brownsville magnified by ten, with people unable to walk and crawling instead.
mentions.quote: You've never experienced what's about to happen
mentions.falsify_match: A revival recognised as larger than Brownsville.

mentions.claim_text: Canada highlighted, with creative ideas coming where the finances are drying up.
mentions.quote: Canada, a creative ideas will come
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of Canadian innovation of that kind.

mentions.claim_text: A major move among American Indians over Mexico, New Mexico and Arizona, leaking into Colorado.
mentions.quote: A major move of America of with American Indians
mentions.falsify_match: A reported revival among tribal communities in the southwest.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why the number is ten rather than thirty, sixty or a hundredfold, and says he will show up in California.
mentions.quote: Father usually goes sevenfold you know 30 60 100fold but 10
mentions.falsify_match: A revival in California on that scale.

mentions.claim_text: A big leader concerning the two-state solution and the things that bring about the end, tied to a man at the White House with a trillion.
mentions.quote: a big leader concerning the two-state solution
mentions.falsify_match: A named figure driving a two-state agreement.

mentions.claim_text: Cuba and Venezuela named as the two countries the mules are coming from, with alliances into Mexico.
mentions.quote: mules are coming from there and there is alliances
mentions.falsify_match: Trafficking networks traced from those countries into Mexico.

mentions.claim_text: Cartel members shown working, which he says is exactly what they saw before the uprising and protesting began.
mentions.quote: It's exactly what we've been seeing before any of this come out
mentions.falsify_match: A prior corpus passage predating the reporting.

mentions.claim_text: Underground tunnels at the border wall with children coming up through California, and the governor turning his head away.
mentions.quote: underground tunnels on the border wall with with children
mentions.falsify_match: Tunnels used to move children found under the California border.

mentions.claim_text: A drum heard as a cry to come, where last time it was a horn.
mentions.quote: it was like a cry to come
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a sound with no reading given.

mentions.claim_text: Woe pronounced three times over America and over Miami, after a vision he says changed him.
mentions.quote: WHOA, WHOA, WHOA, MIAMI
mentions.falsify_match: A judgment event falling on Miami.

mentions.claim_text: Millions if not billions of dead fish everywhere, including at Honolulu in Hawaii, then a named technology figure seen.
mentions.quote: millions, if not billions, of dead fish
mentions.falsify_match: A mass fish die-off on that scale.

mentions.claim_text: They will hide in the caves and ditches and not escape the wrath, for this is the great and terrible day of the Lord.
mentions.quote: THEY WILL HIDE IN THE CAVES
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an eschatological scene with no date.

mentions.claim_text: Great revival will come to the Roman Catholic Church, including Rome and the Vatican, and they will have true revival.
mentions.quote: great revival will come to the Roman Catholic Church
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised revival movement inside the Catholic Church.

mentions.claim_text: Bondage seen throughout Europe, running through the priests and the Catholic Church.
mentions.quote: All throughout Europe is bondage
mentions.falsify_match: Further institutional scandal across European churches.
